skill.name: Fetch a page title
skill.description: Use when someone gives a web address and asks what the page is called: reads the title over the internet.
skill.instructions: Call fetch_title with the https URL. It runs in a sandbox with the internet, and only for this call.

tools.name: fetch_title
tools.description: Read a page over https and answer its status and title.

findings.note: The tool asks for the internet; the person must read this before install.
